about: When a tracked charge's price counts as changed (recurring.price_changed): the latest counted charge against the one before, by more than PRICE_STEP of it and RAISE_MIN. Python (tests/test_subscriptions.py) and the views' preview (web/test/shape.test.ts, priceChanged) both check these. Made-up values.

cases.why: a few cents: under 3% and under 50 cents
a small charge: 3% is under 50 cents, so it takes 50 cents
a small charge that moved more than 50 cents
a one-time purchase read as the price
a first charge has nothing before it
